nom: Clinique Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream

segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, including some in their late 30s to 50s, report the cream is strongly moisturizing and helped with crepey or sagging skin, though one dry-skinned user developed a persistent eyelid twitch after months of use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say it is gentle, hydrating and non-irritating even for reactive skin, while others describe stinging, swelling, redness or chemical-burn-like reactions and warn sensitive skin is at higher risk.
segments.combination: The one reviewer with oily-combination skin finds it suitable in winter but slightly too oily in summer.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers in their 50s to 70s most often report visible smoothing of fine lines, brighter under-eyes and reduced crepiness with consistent use, though a couple say it did not lift sagging skin as hoped.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report visibly softer fine lines, brighter skin and reduced crepiness, some within days to a few months; a few say it did not reduce wrinkles at all or actually worsened sagging/lifting for their eyes.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently describe strong, non-greasy hydration and moisture that lasts through the day, with several noting improvement in dryness within the first weeks.
concerns.redness: A minority of reviewers report new redness, tearing or irritated, raw-looking skin after use, contrasting with the majority who report no redness at all.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers describe compromised skin after use — swelling, stinging, chemical-burn-like sensations or an eyelid twitch that resolved on stopping — though most reviewers report no barrier issues.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer switching from a drugstore routine reports clearer skin with no new breakouts after adding this and other Clinique products; blemishes are otherwise rarely mentioned.
concerns.oiliness: The single reviewer who mentions oiliness has combination skin and finds the cream slightly too oily in summer while fine in winter.

aspects.libelle: Risk of stinging or swelling reaction

extraits.texte: This product has caused what feels like chemical burns on my skin. The skin is red, raw, swollen, and looks generally strange because of it. Received a sample of this product with one of my orders. When I was trying to save myself from using up my normal eye cream, I tossed this in my gym bag to use in the mornings. After a few uses my eyelids became intolerant to everything, they hurt, stung, have become severely inflammed, and the worst part was I did NOT suspect this product. I trusted Clinique for being hypoallergenic and exclusively have been using their eye makeup products for years because they're safe for eyes. As I head into the holidays depressed by my eye rashes, having spent almost a month with no eye makeup to try and heal my eyes, I've only realized today that the sample jar of this product is the one thing I hadn't accounted for. Opening up the 1-star reviews I now see I'm one of many who has had a terrible reaction to this product. I wouldn't risk it with this one. If you have sensitive skin especially, you're opening the door for a terrible, painful time.

59 with dry moderately sensitive skin - I can't use the yellow Dramatically Different at all, nor must if the sunscreen products, so I totally understand the sensitivity concern. I've used exclusively Clinique for decades, and the Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream works great for me! I use just a tiny bit from the end of my eyebrow to my temple and following the bone to just under my eye (but not the tear track area) and concentrating on the 'crows feet' area. Twice a day, usually, and after a month there was a definite improvement! At 59 and until recently an urban desert dweller, I am frequently asked about my skin care and mistaken for a premature grey 30-something.
I have very sensitive skin and this cream is so gentle around my eyes. And I love the heavy creaminess of it.
I have oily combination skin, and this eye cream is suitable for me in winter. In summer, it may be a little oily to me

extraits.titre: Seems to work but long term use caused irritation
extraits.texte: I love this stuff, I have been using it for about a year now, but 2 months ago, I developed a pulsing eyelid twitch, that only went away after I stopped using this. I can't figure out what ingredient would've caused this, or why. It's the only eye cream I've ever used, I figured at age 39, I'd start focusing on my skin, and my skin is dry, so my eyelids were showing some age... but now I can't use it or my eyelid twitches frequently throughout the day. Super bizarre... persisted for 2 months until I stopped using the cream and now it's dissipating.

I have always used neuteogena brand for my face care to lomit my budget. But my skin has never been what i wanted. I decided to budge & buy a cleanser, eye cream & moisturizer from clinique & my skin has never been better. It has cleared up (no breakouts), softer, less red. Really love this line! Never going back. These products are genuinely good for your skin.

After successful cataract surgery on both my eyes I had problems with wrinkled and crepey skin on both my eyelids and brow bone. It took about 2 months of continued use but my eyes are definitely back to normal. This is my regular eye cream now.
